items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: So I met Barney Josephson, and he was very, very, very interested in my coming to New York... So finally, when I did -- when Mr. Josephson talked to me and said, 'Nellie, you've got to come to New York,' I said, 'Well, I'll have to let you know.'

ctx.x: He had a certain idea, and I read a little something about him not long ago, and I could understand it, because I suppose he was a guy who never really got to prove himself. That's the way I feel about him. And he was a very talented, very talented musician. But he had certain ideas, and everything had to be a certain way, the way he thought it should be played, you know. Certain chords, you're used to playing something a certain way, and he worked with a player, he's going to tell the piano player. Well, that…
